description: Export a server's roles, categories, channels, topics, forum tags and permissions as a blueprint (a backup without messages). Optionally save it to a JSON file; apply_blueprint can rebuild from it here or on another server.

bot.description: Use this bot (name or id) instead of choosing automatically

save_to.description: File path to write the JSON to

server.description: Server name or id. Optional when the bot is in one server or DISCORD_GUILD_ID is set.

name: export_server_structure
